name: Mobile Mike's Massage
owner_evidence: Signed in Thumbtack owner review-response text ("Thank you so much..." signed via account) and Thumbtack Credentials section: "Background Check - Michael Sciarratta". Shirt/truck decal show business name + license, not owner name directly; owner name confirmed via Thumbtack credentials block.
service_area: Pompano Beach y todo Broward County (servicio a domicilio). Tarifa de viaje adicional fuera de Broward (Miami-Dade, Palm Beach).

address.note: Servicio movil (el terapeuta viaja a la casa del cliente). Ninguna ficha publica (Google Business, Thumbtack) expone una direccion fisica de oficina; Thumbtack solo muestra el zip de busqueda del usuario (33065), no la base real del negocio. Por eso no se usa direccion ni mapa embed: se uso foto real (camioneta rotulada) en su lugar, segun PIPELINE.md Fase 3 punto 5.

rating_source: Google Maps (ficha de Google Business verificada en vivo hoy: 5.0 de 62 reseñas). Thumbtack reporta ademas 'Exceptional 5.0' con 12 reseñas propias (plataforma distinta, no se suma al conteo de Google).
founded_evidence: Thumbtack perfil: 'Established in 2020' y 'Overview: 6 years in business' (consistente con la fecha de hoy).
license_evidence: Visible impreso en la camiseta de la marca y en el rotulo trasero de la camioneta de trabajo (fotos reales de Google Maps), ademas Thumbtack confirma 'Background checked'.
veteran_evidence: Bio propia del negocio en Thumbtack: 'My passion for massage therapy came after I retired from the military... After getting out of the military I went to LMT school to obtain my license to practice massage.'

process_bio_verbatim_thumbtack: My passion for massage therapy came after I retired from the military. I really truly feel i have the gift to really help my clients in tremendous ways! I put my heart and soul into what i do. My focus for each session is hear what the areas of concern are and work the areas. I will take my time to make sure my clients are happy with the provided service.
process_faq_verbatim_thumbtack: I show up to the clients residence, discuss and issues going on any pains discomfort they are experiencing i set up my table and get to work.
training_verbatim_thumbtack: Lmt school, cupping training, deep tissue training, prenatal training and more.

reviews_google_verbatim.name: Tamera Michel
reviews_google_verbatim.text: First time with Mike. It was a really good massage! Nice pressure and technique. He was professional and made the experience very relaxing. I really enjoyed the session and will definitely book with him again.

reviews_google_verbatim.name: Pieter Niemann
reviews_google_verbatim.text: I had an excellent in-home massage experience with Mike. He was highly professional, with a great attitude and calming presence. His technique was outstanding, very skilled hands that made the session incredibly relaxing and effective. One of the best parts was being able to fully unwind at home afterward instead of having to drive anywhere. Overall, a top-notch experience that I would highly recommend.

reviews_google_verbatim.name: Michelle Grogan
reviews_google_verbatim.text: I honestly can't recommend him enough! He was incredibly professional, kind, and made the whole experience so relaxing from start to finish. I had a lot of tension in my neck and shoulders, and he really took the time to work out all the kinks without making me feel rushed. The hot stone massage was amazing, and the scents he used made everything feel even more calming and peaceful.

reviews_google_verbatim.name: Tsin-Tsin Ong
reviews_google_verbatim.text: Mike is awesome! Always professional, and he knows what he's doing. I always feel better after a massage with Mike. Book now, you won't regret it.
